question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginis?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation together constitute a great accomplishment.
Such great accomplishment relates to the favor of the yoginis.
A practitioner possessing this accomplishment may become dear to them.
inference: The great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation makes one dear to the yoginis.
plain_english: One may become dear to the yoginis through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
